content.title: Order Lifecycle
content.tldr: A cashier creates an order, adds product line items (OrderItems), confirms payment. The system moves the order from pending → processing → completed. On completion, the invoice module is triggered automatically via an internal event.
content.summary: Thu ngân tạo đơn hàng, thêm các mặt hàng, xác nhận thanh toán. Hệ thống tự động chuyển trạng thái đơn hàng và phát hành hóa đơn điện tử khi đơn hoàn tất.

conditions: You only need the Order entity shape — read entity-registry.json
You are working on Invoice — read features/invoice.json (invoice depends on this feature)

do_not: Do NOT allow adding items to an order that is not in 'pending' state
Do NOT allow price or quantity modifications after order moves to 'processing'
Do NOT expose orders from other stores
Do NOT allow manual state transitions that skip steps (e.g. pending → completed directly)
Do NOT hard-delete orders — all states are auditable

items.i_want: to create a new order and add products to it
items.so_that: I can build a customer's cart before confirming payment
acceptance_criteria: Given valid JWT — When POST /api/v1/orders — Then 201 with order { id, orderNumber, status: 'pending', items: [], totalVnd: 0, storeId, cashierId }
Given a pending order — When POST /api/v1/orders/:id/items with { productId, quantity } — Then 200 with updated order including the line item
Given productId not in caller's store — When adding item — Then 404
Given product is deactivated — When adding item — Then 400 'Product is not active'
Given quantity < 1 — When adding item — Then 400
Given order is not in 'pending' state — When adding item — Then 409 'Cannot modify a non-pending order'
OrderItem.unitPriceVnd = product.priceVnd at the moment the item is added (price snapshot)
OrderItem.taxRatePercent = product.taxRatePercent at the moment the item is added (tax snapshot)
Order.totalVnd = sum of (unitPriceVnd × quantity) across all items
edge_cases: Same productId added twice — quantity is incremented (upsert), not duplicate rows
Adding item with quantity = 0 — removes item from order
Order with no items when confirm-payment is called — 400 'Order has no items'
business_rules: BR-ORDER-01: Price and tax rate are snapshotted on OrderItem at item-add time
BR-ORDER-02: totalVnd = sum of (unitPriceVnd × quantity) — recalculated on every item change
BR-ORDER-03: orderNumber is auto-generated: format {storeId-prefix}-{YYYYMMDD}-{sequence} — unique per store per day

items.i_want: to confirm payment and advance the order
items.so_that: the system records the payment and triggers invoice generation
acceptance_criteria: Given a pending order with at least 1 item — When POST /api/v1/orders/:id/confirm-payment — Then 200, order.status = 'processing'
Given order has no items — When confirm-payment — Then 400
Given order is already processing/completed/cancelled — When confirm-payment — Then 409 'Invalid state transition'
After status changes to processing — System emits order.completed event (handled by invoice module)
Payment method field (cash/card) is recorded on the order for audit
edge_cases: Network failure between confirm-payment and invoice generation — order stays in 'processing' until invoice module retries or fails (no orphaned completed orders without invoices)
business_rules: BR-ORDER-04: Only cashier of the store (cashierId matches order.cashierId) OR store-manager may confirm payment — prevents other stores' cashiers
BR-ORDER-05: Payment method recorded: 'cash' | 'card' — stored on order
BR-ORDER-06: On confirm-payment, order transitions to 'processing' immediately — 'completed' only after invoice is issued

items.so_that: the customer changed their mind before payment
acceptance_criteria: Given a pending order — When POST /api/v1/orders/:id/cancel — Then 200, order.status = 'cancelled'
Given order is in processing/completed/refunded — When cancel — Then 409 'Cannot cancel order in current state'
Given caller is not cashier of the store or store-manager — Then 403
Cancelled order is not deleted — it remains with status='cancelled' for audit
edge_cases: Cashier cancels their own order vs. store-manager cancels any order — both allowed
business_rules: BR-ORDER-07: Cancellation is terminal — a cancelled order cannot be re-opened

items.i_want: to view the order history for my store
items.so_that: I can monitor daily sales and investigate discrepancies
acceptance_criteria: Given valid JWT — When GET /api/v1/orders — Then 200 with paginated list of store's orders
Results filterable by: status, date range (createdAt), cashierId
Results include orderNumber, status, totalVnd, cashierId, createdAt
Given caller is cashier — Then returns only their own orders (cashierId = caller.id)
Given caller is store-manager/admin/accountant — Then returns all store orders
edge_cases: Date range spanning midnight — orders created at exactly midnight included in both days' queries
business_rules: BR-ORDER-08: Cashier can only see their own orders in list view
BR-ORDER-09: Pagination required — default page size 20

sections.heading: Business Rules — Consolidated
items: BR-ORDER-01: Price + tax rate snapshotted on OrderItem at item-add time
BR-ORDER-04: Only store's own cashier or manager may confirm payment
BR-ORDER-05: Payment method: 'cash' | 'card' — stored on order
BR-ORDER-06: Order reaches 'completed' only after invoice is issued
BR-ORDER-07: Cancelled orders are terminal and kept for audit
BR-ORDER-08: Cashier list view = own orders only

items.question: Should we support multiple payment methods per order (split payment)?
items.decision: No — single payment method per order for MVP.

items.question: What happens if invoice generation fails after payment is confirmed?
items.decision: Order stays in 'processing'. Invoice module retries. If all retries fail, order moves to 'cancelled' and a bug is logged. No money movement at this layer (payment is external).

items.question: Refund flow — UI in Sprint 3?
items.decision: Backend state machine supports 'refunded'. UI deferred to Sprint 4.
